biotools.summary: sysVI is a single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) integration method that employs VampPrior and cycle-consistency constraints to improve biological signal interpretation. It is described in a peer-reviewed publication and aims to provide a framework for data harmonization and analysis across diverse datasets.
